description: Runs one data tool with its JSON input: Google Maps places with contacts, YouTube videos / transcripts / comments, Indeed, LinkedIn and 13 other job boards, LinkedIn companies, Google News and Trends, Google Ads library, TikTok comments, Pinterest, Airbnb, Redfin, AliExpress, app stores, website contacts and SEO checks, sanctions, clinical trials and more. catalog_read what=prices lists every tool with an input example. Each tool has its own price, $0.01-0.08 per capped run (catalog_read what=prices). tier=max runs a bigger job for: google-maps-scraper ($0.35), indeed-jobs-scraper ($0.15), linkedin-company-scraper ($0.15), linkedin-jobs-scraper ($0.12), youtube-comments-scraper ($0.15). Runs live on Apify; 10 s-4 min. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

input.description: The tool's JSON input (see its example in catalog).

tier.description: max = bigger caps, only for the tools listed above.

tool.description: Tool id from catalog_read what=prices, e.g. google-maps-scraper.

name: data_tool_run
title: Run one of 70 data tools (Maps, jobs, YouTube, ...)
